name: docker-layer-optimizer
description: Learn how a project changes and reduce Docker cache invalidation and redeploy cost.

interface.shortDescription: Learn change patterns and reduce rebuild cost
interface.longDescription: Measures BuildKit cache hits and resulting image layers, then combines those observations with Git history to reduce repeated Docker build work.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this project's Docker layers and suggest the highest-impact cache improvement.
Use recent project changes to reorganize this Dockerfile for faster rebuilds.
